description: Defines a lightweight, flexible Codable wrapper 'AnyCodable' that can encode and decode heterogeneous JSON payloads, supporting various types including dictionaries and arrays, for use in JSON serialization scenarios.

classes.name: AnyCodable
classes.description: A struct conforming to Codable, Hashable, and @unchecked Sendable that can wrap any value to facilitate JSON encoding and decoding of heterogeneous payloads.

methods.name: init(_ value: Any)
methods.description: Initializes AnyCodable with a value, normalizing the value to handle special cases like CFBoolean.

methods.name: init(from decoder: Decoder) throws
methods.description: Decodes a value from a single value container, supporting multiple primitive and container types, or throws an error if unsupported.

methods.name: encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws
methods.description: Encodes the wrapped value into a single value container, handling various supported types.

methods.name: == (lhs: AnyCodable, rhs: AnyCodable) -> Bool
methods.description: Equality operator to compare two AnyCodable instances based on their underlying values.

methods.name: hash(into hasher: inout Hasher)
methods.description: Hashes the underlying value with type-specific logic to support Hashable conformance.
